capabilities: Show a dashboard with vault stats, tasks, tickets and time totals
Manage tasks and tickets with reminders, templates and PDF export
Track active time per category into daily Time Log notes
Add writing helpers like a slash menu, lockable callouts and page breaks
Study topics with quiz cards and spaced repetition
disambiguation: Not a flashcard app despite the name; 'Deck' here is a bundled dashboard with six switchable modules.
extras: Not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; installed by downloading a ZIP from GitHub releases and copying it into .obsidian/plugins/, not via the community plugin browser. Replaces the author's earlier six separate 1.x plugins, whose data is copied over once. Safe mode keeps all modules off after a failed start.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in central dashboard that combines task, ticket and time tracking with study and writing aids in one themed workspace.

relations.evidence: One Time Log note per day (Core/Time Log/YYYY-MM-DD.md), written for an AI agent to pass on to Jira.

summary: Modular personal command centre that adds a dashboard, task and ticket tracking, automatic time logging, study tools and writing helpers.
